_note: Rules that turn an episode's beats into cue sheets. Every rule carries the editorial purpose that will be printed next to the cue. Proposals from docs/longform/SOUND-DESIGN-RESEARCH.md section 6 (hypotheses for a person to approve; the reference evidence for each is stated there). 'first' = only the first matching beat. 'group' = one cue spanning a run of consecutive beats of the listed scene types. Levels are dB relative to the narration (negative = quieter). Timing = beat start from the narration word count at 2.5 words per second. Rules whose trigger words matched a beat that did not fit the stated purpose (record scratch, applause, clock tick) were removed after reading the narration of the matched beats; a rule stays only if the beat it fires on really is the thing the purpose says.
